title: Cure the illness, don't just kill the pain
body:
Turkish Cyprus has a population of about 150 000 people. Last week I read in one of their papers that 1/2 of
their budget goes into importing medicine! People are wasting so much. The doctors give too much. The
patients use one or two spoons of the bottle, and then they throw it away. With the tablets the same. So much
medicine is being wasted. People are becoming more and more impatient. Patients have forgotten how to be
patient.
The old medicines had two different effects: they killed the pain and treated the illnesses. Nowadays people
only want to kill the pains thinking that when the pain has stopped, the illness is gone too. But sometimes the
illness will just fall asleep an then attack you again. It is always better to be patient with pain, but use some
cure for the illness. Every illness is a burden. That is why people run to escape from pain.
01.01.1997
